title: Low-field strain-driven phase diagram of (Bi1/2Na1/2)TiO3–SrTiO3–LiNbO3 lead-free relaxor ceramics for actuator applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26173-26189
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00669H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen Hoang Thien Khoi, Nguyen Hoc Thang
A new ternary system, (1 − x − y)(Bi1/2Na1/2)TiO3–xSrTiO3–yLiNbO3 (BNST100x/100yLN) ceramics, is designed and systematically investigated to reduce high driving fields and large hysteresis in conventional (Bi1/2Na1/2)TiO3 (BNT)-based ceramics.
